sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Conveyance, Signals, Railroad, Work Zones
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Conveyance, Signals, Railroad, Work Zones

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Walkers and conveyance riders share identical crosswalk rights, since the manual folds every human-powered device into its pedestrian term [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint conveyance-law; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F01 and sec04-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A02
Solid red orders a full stop for through traffic, while flashing red turns the signal into a stop sign for every approach [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint signal-indications; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F09.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A02
Solid yellow asks whether you can stop, demanding a hold when possible, while flashing yellow grants passage conditioned only on caution and yielding [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint signal-indications; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec04-F10 and sec04-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A02
The steady red arrow forbids the turn outright, while the flashing yellow arrow permits a left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint signal-arrows; prereq_hint sec04-F13; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec04-F13 and sec04-F15.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A02
The steady yellow arrow warns a protected turn is ending, while the steady green arrow grants the turn but never the straight path [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint signal-arrows; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec04-F14 and sec04-F16.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A02
Guide signs name places and distances, service signs name traveler comforts, and route signs name the road itself by shape [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint sign-families; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F05, sec04-F06, and sec04-F07.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A03
Active crossings command obedience to lights and gates, while passive crossings offer only a crossbuck with a stop or yield sign and demand a visual check [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-crossings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F20 and sec04-F21.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A03
Buses, hired rides, and hazmat haulers must always halt short of the rails, while other drivers halt for flashing lights and lowered gates [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-crossings; prereq_hint sec04-F22; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec04-F20 and sec04-F22.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A03
A stall with a train in view adds restart attempts and engineer-waving to the evacuation, while a stall with no train in view goes straight to evacuation plus the ENS call [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-emergencies; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec04-F23 and sec04-F28.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A03
The fifteen-foot waiting gap keeps a stopped car clear of the nearest rail, while the fifteen-to-fifty band marks where buses and hazmat must halt before crossing [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-distances; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F22 and sec04-F27.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A05
Arrow boards announce closures, channelizing hardware steers the path, and flaggers direct traffic with paddles that must be obeyed [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint work-devices; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F33, sec04-F34, and sec04-F35.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A01
Skateboards and scooters count as pedestrian conveyances with full crosswalk rights, not as vehicles [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint conveyance-law; prereq_hint sec04-F02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec04-F01 and sec04-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0010]
